parameters.name: BandwidthType
parameters.description:
The bandwidth type of the GA instance. Valid values:

*   **Sharing**
*   **Exclusive** (default)

parameters.name: GlobalAccelerationInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the GA instance.

parameters.name: IncludeReservationData
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return information about pending orders. Valid values:

*   **false** (default)
*   **true**

parameters.name: IpAddress
parameters.description: The public IP address of the GA instance.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the GA instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the GA instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ServerId
parameters.description: The ID of the backend service instance.

parameters.name: ServiceLocation
parameters.description:
The region of the backend service. Valid values:

*   **china-mainland**
*   **north-america**
*   **asia-pacific**
*   **europe**

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the GA instance. Valid values:

*   **Available**
*   **Inuse**
*   **Associating**
*   **Unassociating**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-global-acceleration-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --include-reservation-data false --global-acceleration-instance-id ga-234sljmxaz0000 --ip-address 12.xx.xx.78 --name GA-1 --status Available --bandwidth-type Exclusive --service-location china-mainland --server-id i-sxjblddejj9x0000 --page-number 10 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc DescribeGlobalAccelerationInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Status Available --BandwidthType Exclusive --ServerId 'i-sxjblddejj9x0000' --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 10 --ServiceLocation 'china-mainland' --IpAddress '12.xx.xx.78' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --GlobalAccelerationInstanceId 'ga-234sljmxaz0000' --IncludeReservationData false --Name 'GA-1'
